2+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales with consistent performance in the €5K–€25K ACV range .

Understanding of AI LLMs and GPTs, and ability to articulate their business applications .

Experience selling to COOs, operations leaders, or delivery heads at professional services firms who care deeply about margin and capacity .

Strong discovery instincts with the ability to map out how work moves from a client request into production .

Proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach (or equivalent), and Sales Navigator .

These ranges are a guideline; actual base salary and OTE may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified .

Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

Career coaching & support

Inclusive family building benefits

Long-term savings or retirement plans

jobs.description:
The IT Systems Engineering team builds the systems and processes that keep Asana running: endpoint management, identity, and the enterprise applications every Asana employee uses every day. As Manager of IT Applications and Client Platform Engineering, you’ll lead four engineers: two on client platform, two on applications. You report directly to the Head of IT Systems Engineering. This is a player/coach role: you set direction, run planning, and step in on escalations and architecture decisions while your engineers own most of the day-to-day. Your primary depth is in endpoint engineering; you have enough SaaS administration background to lead the apps side without micromanaging it. We’re looking for someone who knows endpoint work deeply and is ready to grow as a manager. Your title history matters less than technical foundation and how you work with people.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you’re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

- Lead and develop your team. Manage and mentor four engineers (two on CPE, two on Apps). Set priorities, clear blockers, and help each person grow.

- Own the client platform program. Set strategy and lead execution for Asana’s endpoint fleet: macOS, Windows, and mobile. This means MDM infrastructure, zero-touch deployment, software catalog, and OS lifecycle. We’re primarily an Apple shop with a growing Windows footprint.

- Strengthen endpoint security. Work with the Corporate Security team to harden our endpoint posture, respond to incidents, and build initiatives that connect security priorities and endpoints.

- Oversee the applications engineering function. Your Apps engineers manage the SaaS portfolio: Asana, Google Workspace, Slack, Zendesk, DocuSign, 1Password, Slab, Figma, and more. You set direction, stay close enough to catch problems early, and step in when something needs senior judgment.

- Be the technical escalation. When a hard endpoint problem surfaces, an MDM decision needs to be made, or a cross-team initiative needs senior ownership, that’s you.

- Push automation and efficiency. Spot opportunities to reduce manual work through scripting, APIs, and workflow tooling. Build the expectation that if something is repetitive, the team automates it.

- Work across the organization. Partner with Corporate Security, HR, Legal, and other business teams to understand what they need, communicate what IT is building, and ship solutions that work.

- Document and share knowledge. Make sure your team documents clearly and hands off processes that others can follow.

About you

- Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

- Experience managing client endpoint infrastructure: macOS and Windows required, mobile (iOS/Android) a strong plus.

- Hands-on with MDM platforms like Jamf, Intune, BigFix, or AirWatch; familiar with zero-touch deployment methods.

- Comfortable with identity platforms like Okta and how they connect to endpoint management.

- Can write scripts in Bash or PowerShell; familiar with APIs and orchestration tools like Workato.

- Enough SaaS administration experience — Google Workspace, Slack, and similar — to lead a team that owns it.

- Some management experience. This is a good role for a senior engineer who has led projects or a small team and is ready for the next step. We care more about how you think technically and how you work with people than what your title has been.

- You communicate clearly, prioritize in writing, and know when to solve a problem yourself and when to hand it off.

At Asana, we’re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you’re interested in this role and don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

- Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

- Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

- Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

- Experience with OSquery and Santa

- Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

- Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

jobs.description:
Introduction
Very Good Ventures is a global consultancy that delivers clients elegant solutions using disruptive technologies. At VGV, we believe that building very good technology starts with a culture of excellence, collaboration, humility, and openness – and of course, have a very good time while doing it. We place our company values and culture at the forefront of everything we do.

Rising to prominence as the foremost Flutter experts, VGV is at an exciting stage of growth as we expand our global presence and our range of strategic services. Our mission is to lead the most influential companies through new digital frontiers and improve the relationship between technology and those that create, manage, and experience it. VGV’s client roster spans industries, including Toyota, Google, Dow Jones, JSX, Betterment, and Norwegian Cruise Lines.

People come to work at VGV to solve challenging problems with the newest technology, alongside some of the best talent in the industry, and in a culture that remains steadfastly dedicated to its employees.

Overview
Very Good Ventures is a product consultancy. Our engagements span different clients, stacks, and constraints, and they change fast. Our product development focus leans heavily toward cloud infrastructure and, more recently, toward building and deploying AI agents and agentic infrastructure for our clients. We need someone who can ramp up quickly on new projects and stacks, stay credible while doing it, and carry a project from a first sales conversation through to a running production system.

This is a consulting role that demands deep engineering, not an engineering role that happens to sit inside a consultancy. You will define and lead our backend, infrastructure, and agentic-infrastructure practice, represent that expertise in front of clients and prospects, and ship the work yourself.

If you want a heads-down platform role at a single product company, this is not it. If you want to shape a practice, earn client trust, be exposed to multiple projects and companies, and still write the code that matters, this role is then what you’re looking for.

What you’ll do
Client leadership and practice definition

Act as the credible technical voice in pre-sales and client conversations. Help scope engagements, shape technical direction, and set expectations that we can deliver against.

Partner with business development and leadership to estimate work, phase delivery, and protect both margin and delivery risk on fixed budgets and immovable dates.

Define and evolve VGV’s backend, infrastructure, and agentic-infrastructure practice. Set the standards, patterns, and reusable approaches that the rest of the team builds on.

Translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders. Anchor on business outcomes and risk, and command the room without drowning people in jargon.

Deliver quality across simultaneous engagements with different requirements and constraints, and ramp fast on stacks you have not touched before.

AI Agents and Agentic Infrastructure

Design, build, deploy and scale production AI agents and the infrastructure that runs them. This is core to the role.

Establish patterns for observability, cost control, safety, and reliability specific to agentic systems.

Platform and infrastructure
Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure with infrastructure -as-code tooling such as Terraform or OpenTofu.

Build staged development environments and the CI/CD pipelines that make deployments rapid, reliable, and automated.

Own observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting for performance, usage, and security.

Set best practices for security, compliance, and cost optimization across cloud deployments.

Backend and development integration
Build, deploy, and scale backend (micro)services with a focus on high-availability and resilience.

Design and maintain backend APIs and integration services. Strong API design judgement across REST, GraphQL, and gRPC.

Apply backend architectural patterns appropriately and explain the trade-offs behind your choices.

Collaborate with front-end teams on integrations and performance.

What we’re looking for
8+ years as a Backend or Full Stack Engineer, with a strong emphasis on DevOPps, programmatic infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineering.

Demonstrated experience building and scaling production AI-powered services or agents. Prototypes are not enough. We want to hear about systems that ran in production.

Deep expertise in infrastructure-as-code and cloud resource management. We care about the principles you carry between the tools, not a specific tool or vendor.

Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.

A track record of designing and scaling

BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) IT is seeking an experienced and results-driven Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Business Systems Analyst to join our Business Enablement and Digital Experience Team. In this pivotal role, you will help revolutionize how our employees interact with our digital ecosystem by leveraging Nexthink and ServiceNow to synthesize real-time data, productivity metrics, and survey feedback into tangible improvements. By analyzing systemic friction points and supporting cross-functional initiatives to eliminate them, you will effectively bridge the gap between complex IT operations and a frictionless user experience. Join us in building a world-class Digital Experience Scorecard and leading the charge toward a more intuitive, transparent, and efficient digital workplace.

The Operations Strategic Capabilities Unit plays a fundamental role in enabling efficient business and program execution – from strategic capital investments, industrial operations and an efficient supply chain, to state-of-the-art manufacturing and test operations and top-notch facilities management.

jobs.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re...
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

- Global-level admin experience with Microsoft Intune

- Ability to script in Powershell

- Admin experience with 1Password Enterprise Password Manager (EPM)

What you can expect:

- Lead the planning and implementation of large-scale device infrastructure projects with broad impact across the organization

- Drive IT Change Management initiatives related to endpoint management, software patching, and fleet operations

- Manage and administer cloud-based Apple MDM platforms (Iru), including custom configuration profiles and advanced policy management

- Apply AI tooling to real infrastructure problems (automated remediation, smarter alerting, reducing the manual toil that slows device ops) and have a hand in deciding where it goes next.

- Own third-party software patching workflows that keep the fleet current with minimal disruption to employees

- Approach all rollouts with a strong user experience focus. Phasing thoughtfully, communicating proactively, and designing for minimal disruption

- Contribute to designing and implementing best practices, policies, and procedures for the Device Infrastructure Services team

- Build relationships with key stakeholders across the organization

- Be available for occasional 24/7 on-call shifts to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve incidents.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $117,000 USD and $164,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $103,000 CAD and $144,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

jobs.description:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

As an Information System Engineer in our IT Digital Employee department (reporting to the Manager, End User Engineering), you will design, implement, and support Zscaler’s global end-user computing (EUC) environment across Windows, macOS, BYOD, and Mobile platforms. Based in Bangalore, India (Hybrid), you will collaborate with IT, Security, and Platform Engineering teams to build secure, cloud-first workspaces fully aligned to Zero Trust principles—balancing priority operational escalations with high-value engineering projects.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

- Deploy, configure, and maintain corporate-managed endpoints (Windows/macOS/BYOD/Mobile) in alignment with Zscaler security baselines, least-privilege standards, and automated lifecycle workflows.

- Execute vulnerability management workflows using CrowdStrike and Zscaler UVM (Avalor); triage, prioritize, and track risk remediation using Jira, ServiceNow, and executive compliance dashboards.

- Monitor system performance and user satisfaction using Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) and Omnissa, implementing self-healing policies and proactive automation to balance security with productivity.

- Participate and contribute to complex endpoint issues and security threats, conducting root cause analysis (RCA) and documenting actionable SOPs and runbooks for support teams.

- Contribute for technical initiatives including platform upgrades, virtualization pilots, and security tool rollouts while working cross-functionally across IT Operations, Security, and business leaders.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

- You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

- You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

- You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

- You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

- 4+ years in enterprise EUC, endpoint management, or desktop engineering within cloud-first environments.

- Deep proficiency in Windows and macOS administration alongside UEM platforms such as CrowdStrike, Jamf, Microsoft Intune/MEM, Workspace ONE, and ServiceNow.

- Proven track record running vulnerability management, patch compliance, and risk mitigation at enterprise scale.

- Strong technical diagnostic skills across device security, OS performance, network stacks, hardware, and productivity software.

- Solid foundation in Zero Trust architecture, excellent stakeholder communication skills, and the flexibility for after-hours on-call or on-site support during major incidents.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Hands-on experience writing scripts in PowerShell, Python, or equivalent languages to automate routine operational tasks.

- Prior experience with end-user digital experience monitoring tools such as Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) or Omnissa.

- Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator, Jamf Certified, CrowdStrike, or Zscaler credentials.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Secure Devices is responsible for ensuring that every client endpoint at Stripe adheres to our rigorous security standards. Our services play a crucial role in detecting and preventing data loss, restricting software execution to only approved software, and providing attestation capabilities to securely manage device identities. We operate both on-device and backend services across multiple platform types. Our users-first approach ensures that we’re empowering Stripes to be as productive as possible while protecting user data.

What you’ll do

As a software engineer on Secure Devices, you will work at the intersection of software development, security, and client platform engineering. You will work with teams across Security, Infrastructure and Corporate Engineering to drive strategic projects to better secure Stripe endpoints, build infrastructure for supporting new platforms, and operate services critical to securing over 10,000 Stripe devices.

Responsibilities

- Contribute to the secure design and implementation of Stripe’s mobile expansion initiative

- Act as the subject matter expert on iOS security by advising partner teams on iOS security best practices and secure-by-design architectures

- Design, build and maintain Stripe’s endpoint security software. This includes developing telemetry and prevention capabilities via macOS system extensions that run on all Stripe macOS devices

- Collaborate closely with partner teams to define and measure the secure configuration of Stripe’s client platforms (macOS, iOS/Android, ChromeOS)

- Operate high RPS backend services providing critical controls and security configuration to Stripe endpoints

- Drive down usage of unapproved, untrusted software while creating a surprisingly great user experience for onboarding new, approved software

- Manage and improve device attestation flows to ensure Stripe’s device and user identities are kept secure

- Identify opportunities on Stripe client platforms to improve our security posture and resiliency against malware and advanced persistent threats

- Build and maintain a users-first data loss prevention program to protect against accidental and malicious data exfiltration

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

- 4+ years of relevant experience securing iOS and/or macOS platforms

- 4+ years of software engineering experience writing Go, Swift or Objective-C

- Deep expertise securing devices within the Apple ecosystem

- Understanding of the current threat landscape and how to defend Apple devices against modern threats

- High standards for code quality and a constructive attitude to help others raise the bar

- An ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment

- The ability to drive clear next steps when encountering ambiguous spaces without clear lines of ownership

- Empathy, strong communication skills and a deep respect for the power of collaboration

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing endpoint detection and response software

- Knowledge of macOS or iOS internals and how they can be used to build security controls and software

- Exposure to data loss prevention strategies

- Ability to develop backend networked applications capable of handling a high number of requests

- General proficiency in securing client devices

- Understanding of topics such as platform hardening, malware detection, and endpoint management through configuration as code

- Understanding of networking protocols across various levels of the stack

- TCP, DNS, SSH, TLS, HTTP

- Linux system administration knowledge

- Additional experience securing alternative platforms including Windows and Android

- Experience working with AWS cloud services

jobs.description:
Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

We are seeking a skilled Endpoint Management System Administrator to support and operate a modern enterprise endpoint environment. This is a highly hands-on operational role responsible for administering and maintaining enterprise endpoint management platforms, with daily use of Microsoft Intune and Tanium to manage endpoint configuration, compliance, patching, and software deployments.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing Windows and macOS endpoints, with working knowledge of Linux, and will be comfortable performing daily endpoint administration tasks using Microsoft Intune and Tanium. These platforms are used extensively for endpoint visibility, machine compliance, vulnerability remediation, software updates, and software deployments. Jamf is also used to manage macOS systems within the environment.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

Administer and support enterprise endpoints across Windows desktops and servers, macOS, and Linux.

Use Microsoft Intune and Tanium as primary endpoint management platforms for daily endpoint administration and operational management such as:

Endpoint visibility and real-time inventory

Machine compliance monitoring and enforcement

Operating system and third-party software updates

Software packaging, deployments, and remediation

Vulnerability identification and remediation

Manage Windows endpoints using Microsoft Intune and Group Policy Objects (GPO).

Manage macOS endpoints using Jamf, including configuration profiles, policies, and application deployments.

Execute and track vulnerability remediation efforts, ensuring timely patching and risk reduction across all endpoint platforms.

Support and maintain enterprise cloud print solutions.

Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and service teams to ensure endpoint configurations align with security standards and operational requirements.

Implementation and management of endpoint security baselines and configuration standards aligned with CIS Security Controls.

Create and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, and operational runbooks.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on strengthening endpoint security, automation, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Minimum of Three (3) years of relevant experience

Proven experience managing enterprise desktops and servers in a large-scale environment.

Hands-on operational experience administering endpoints using Microsoft Intune.Strong working knowledge of:

Microsoft Intune (Windows endpoint management)

Windows Autopilot

Group Policy (GPO)

Jamf (macOS management)

Experience administering Windows desktop and server environments.

Working knowledge of macOS and Linux administration.

Demonstrated experience managing machine compliance, software patching, and vulnerability remediation.

Strong troubleshooting skills and experience operating in a large, complex enterprise environment.

Experience implementing or supporting device compliance policies and their integration with conditional access controls using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID.

Preferred Qualifications

Additional hands-on experience using Tanium for endpoint management, compliance reporting, patching, and software deployment.

Experience managing third-party application updates across diverse endpoint platforms.

Familiarity with modern endpoint security concepts such as least privilege, zero trust, and compliance baselines.

Experience supporting cloud-first or hybrid endpoint management strategies.

Compensation & Benefits

The expected pay range will be $95,000 - $105,000. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.

Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; based on the type of position

Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.

Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.

Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.

Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. jobs.description:
Position Summary

KECH is seeking an experienced and versatile Systems Engineer to support the company’s information technology infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, end-user computing environment, and contact-center technology platforms. The position is REMOTE with the occasional requirement of being IN-OFFICE. Applicants must be located near a KECH office location in Williamsburg, KY or El Paso, TX.

This position will be responsible for administering servers, desktops, networks, identity systems, security technologies, and business-critical applications. The Systems Engineer will also assist with cybersecurity monitoring, incident response, vulnerability scanning and remediation, system hardening, technology evaluations, and compliance activities.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working across multiple technical disciplines and resolving issues involving servers, endpoints, networks, cloud services, cybersecurity tools, telecommunications, and call-center platforms. This is a hands-on position suited for an experienced IT professional who can independently troubleshoot complex problems while working collaboratively with internal teams, vendors, customers, and technology partners.

Key Responsibilities

Server and Systems Administration

Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Windows and Linux Server environments.
Support physical servers, virtual servers, cloud-hosted systems, and related infrastructure.
Administer server operating systems, system services, storage, permissions, scheduled tasks, and applications.
Monitor server availability, performance, capacity, event logs, and system health.
Perform server patching, upgrades, maintenance, and remediation activities.
Assist with backup administration, restoration testing, business continuity, and disaster-recovery planning.
Troubleshoot server, operating-system, application, authentication, and performance issues.
Maintain system configurations, inventories, diagrams, procedures, and administrative documentation.

Desktop and End-User Computing

Configure, deploy, administer, and support desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and related equipment.
Build and maintain standardized workstation images and device configurations.
Manage endpoint patching, software deployment, configuration management, and security policies.
Troubleshoot Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, browsers, productivity tools, and business applications.
Support endpoint encryption, antivirus, EDR/XDR, web filtering, multifactor authentication, and device-security controls.
Manage hardware and software inventories throughout the technology lifecycle.
Assist users with technical issues while providing professional and responsive customer service.
Identify recurring support problems and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Network Administration

Configure, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot local-area and wide-area network infrastructure.
Support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VPNs, VLANs, and internet connectivity.
Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and connectivity issues.
Assist with network segmentation, firewall rules, remote-access solutions, and secure connectivity.
Monitor network availability, utilization, performance, and security events.
Maintain network diagrams, device inventories, configuration records, and administrative documentation.
Coordinate with internet, telecommunications, managed-service, and equipment providers.
Support Ubiquiti or comparable network technologies.
Assist with the design and implementation of secure network improvements.

Cybersecurity Operations

Monitor and investigate security alerts.
Assist with incidents involving phishing, malware, ransomware, credential theft, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and insider threats.
Support incident containment, eradication, recovery, documentation, and post-incident review activities.
Administer or support Trend Micro Vision One.
Manage or support website allowlists, blocklists, DNS filtering, and secure web-gateway technologies.
Conduct proactive reviews of endpoint, server, identity, cloud, and network-security events.
Maintain incident-response procedures, investigation records, corrective-action plans, and lessons-learned documentation.
Escalate significant incidents to management and appropriate internal teams.
Assist with security-awareness activities and employee cybersecurity training.

Vulnerability Management and System Hardening

Perform or coordinate vulnerability scanning.
Analyze vulnerability findings and prioritize remediation based on severity, exploitability, asset criticality, and operational risk.
Coordinate remediation activities involving servers, workstations, network devices, applications, and cloud systems.
Validate that vulnerabilities have been successfully remediated.
Apply or recommend security-hardening controls based on CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, vendor guidance, and organizational standards.
Track vulnerability-aging, remediation status, exceptions, and accepted risks.
Prepare technical reports and management dashboards showing vulnerability trends and remediation progress.
Identify weaknesses in the technology environment and recommend practical corrective actions.

Technology Evaluation and Implementation

Evaluate new hardware, software, cloud services, cybersecurity products, artificial-intelligence tools, and business applications.
Identify security, privacy, integration, support, licensing, and operational risks before implementation.
Assist with proofs of concept, application testing, system validation, and implementation planning.
Prepare recommendations that describe business benefits, technical requirements, costs, risks, and alternatives.
Participate in technology deployments, upgrades, migrations, integrations, and decommissioning projects.
Confirm that new systems meet security, performance, supportability, and business requirements.

Help Desk and Operational Support

Serve as an escalation point for complex help-desk and technical-support issues.
Diagnose and resolve problems involving hardware, software, networks, authentication, servers, security tools, and business applications.
Prioritize incidents based on business impact, urgency, security risk, and contractual requirements.
Document troubleshooting activities, resolutions, root causes, and follow-up actions.
Participate in an after-hours or on-call support rotation when required.
Support remote locations, distributed employees, call-center operations, and customer-facing systems.
Coordinate planned maintenance to minimize operational disruption.
Communicate outages, service interruptions, security events, and recovery status clearly to affected stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in systems administration, network administration, cybersecurity, technical support, or a closely related field.
Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows and Linux server environments.
Experience configuring or troubleshooting routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and VLANs.
Experience with endpoint-management, patch-management, software-deployment, or configuration-management technologies.
Experience supporting Microsoft 365 services and applications.
Experience with vulnerability-scanning, endpoint-security, antivirus, and XDR technologies.
Working knowledge of cybersecurity incident response, security hardening, access control, and vulnerability remediation.
Experience applying CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIGs or similar standards.
Experience with backup, disaster-recovery, monitoring, ticketing, automation, and remote-management technologies.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Technical Support: Provide advanced technical support for Windows and Apple devices, including desktops, laptops, iPads, iPhones, printers, and peripherals. Ensure timely and effective resolution of help desk tickets and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.

Description Of Services

EUC Engineer Job Description Role Summary The End User Computing (EUC) Engineer is responsible for engineering, managing, securing, and optimizing the enterprise end user technology environment. This role oversees the configuration, deployment, and lifecycle management of desktops, mobile devices, applications, operating system images, and related EUC platforms such as Intune, SCCM, Active Directory, and JAMF. The engineer ensures reliable end user services, compliance with standards, and continuous improvement of workplace technology Key Responsibilities 1. Standard Operating Environment (SOE) Create and maintain SOE images aligned with client standards. Develop new SOE configuration image projects. Manage, maintain, and update existing software images. Perform unit testing and quality assurance on images. Validate images for software conflicts and compatibility issues. Conduct malware protection activities during image creation. Perform installation, integration, and functional testing. Update ITSM records upon successful image execution. Document all SOE configurations and build procedures. 2. Platform Engineering (Intune Administration) Recommend EUC platform standards, architecture, and design. Provide portfolio recommendations on desktop applications and consolidation efforts. Test compatibility of new standards with existing infrastructure. Document exceptions to standards. Conduct product/tool evaluations for EUC technologies. Track and document activities within ITSM. 3. Software Distribution & Management (Intune/SCCM) Develop standards for software packaging and distribution. Create deployment ready software packages (MSI/intunewin/etc.). Perform pre deployment testing for all software packages. Ensure compliance with software licensing requirements. Schedule and execute software deployments. Monitor distribution success and resolve installation failures. Maintain up to date software distribution documentation. Report distribution metrics and performance. 4. Mobile Device Management (Intune MDM) Configure and administer the MDM platform. Develop and maintain device enrollment procedures. Configure and manage device security policies and compliance rules. Deploy and manage mobile applications. Monitor compliance status and generate compliance reports. Maintain MDM documentation. Provide user support for device enrollment and configuration. 5. Active Directory Management Implement and maintain AD security controls. Monitor AD services, performance, and policies. Create and modify Group Policy Objects (GPOs). Optimize GPO design, structure, and performance. Maintain AD documentation. Generate periodic AD security and compliance reports. Conduct periodic AD health checks. 6. Apple Device Management (JAMF) (You had only JAMF listed; below is the completed section based on industry standards let me know if you want it tailored.) Administer and maintain JAMF Pro for macOS/iOS devices. Create and deploy configuration profiles and policies. Package, test, and deploy macOS applications. Integrate JAMF with identity/security systems as needed. Monitor device compliance and inventory. Troubleshoot enrollment and device management issues. Maintain documentation for all JAMF-related processes. Required Skills & Qualifications Strong experience with Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Windows OS engineering. Experience with SOE image creation, maintenance, and deployment. Hands-on experience with software packaging and endpoint security. Knowledge of Active Directory, GPO management, and identity services. Experience with mobile device management and security compliance. Familiarity with JAMF for macOS/iOS environments. Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for automation. Strong troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and documentation skills.

Deliverables

Process Flows -Mentor and Knowledge transfer to client project team members -Participate as primary, co and/or contributing author on any and all project deliverables associated with their assigned areas of responsibility -Participate in data conversion and data maintenance -Provide best practice and industry specific solutions -Advise on and provide alternative (out of the box) solutions -Provide thought leadership as well as hands on technical configuration/development as needed. -Participate as a team member of the functional team -Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.description:
SE-Consulting Services-Enterprise Networking Infrastructure Engineer III

Join our AI & Engineering team by transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You will collaborate with talented professionals, reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages innovative engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 08/10/2026.

Work you'll do

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure/Connected Edge offering delivers specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments. We modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge and develop new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technological advancements.

As part of our networking team, you will engage with Practitioners and Professionals from various disciplines within both our consulting practices and from our client's organizations. During engagements, exposure to multiple technologies will provide you with opportunities to become an expert and to expand your skillset into new areas. Our practitioners lead/support technical teams to architect, build, and deploy modern solutions across public, private and hybrid cloud environments. Our practitioners are expected to own and deliver their respective outcomes while managing different clients and other stakeholders.

The Team

This role is aligned to our Enterprise Networks team, which includes specializations across LAN, WAN, Data Center, Security, Observability, Automation, and Telephony. You will design and deliver leading solutions for our clients while building reusable artifacts to accelerate our future engagements.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of experience with enterprise networking technologies:Solid understanding and experience with networking fundamentals, including Layer 2 protocols like ARP, 802.1Q, and Spanning Tree; Layer 3 protocols such as BGP and OSPF; Layer 4-7 technologies such as TCP, Load-Balancers, Firewalls, and DNS.5+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience and large scale, enterprise class consulting or systems integration experience5+ years designing and implementing Network Access Control (NAC) solutions5+ years designing and implementing wireless networksAbility to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serveMust be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred

Proven experience across project phases including plan, build, test, and transition of solutions to achieve project goalsNetwork certifications e.g., CCIE / JNCIE, CCNP / JNCP, CCNA, or equivalentSpecialization with installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and supporting of Networking equipment - hands on keyboard experienceExperience in documenting and articulating network topologies to broad audiencesFamiliarity with network security devices such as next-generation firewalls and intrusion prevention systems; strong understanding of the fitment and use-cases of such systems across an enterprise network and how they fit in with a network segmentation initiativeNetwork Security certifications are a plus (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, HPE)Exposure to enterprise network monitoring platforms and solutions; ability to gather useful insights from reports to further justify a proposed solutionFundamental understanding of the value public cloud offers to customers and how private networks are provisioned; proven experience with interconnecting enterprise networks to public cloud environments either through leased lines or virtual private networks (VPN) over the internetCloud certifications are a plus (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)Strong understanding of the value that software-defined networking and network orchestration provides network operators. Experience with designing and deploying SD-WAN is a plusAbility to model and build test virtual networks for proof of concepts that showcase leading practicesKnowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols (DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SSL/TLS, WINS, NTP, FTP, HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, LDAP, and Microsoft AD)Knowledge of wireless controllers and differing access point deployment methods for enterprise clientsUnderstanding of network traffic analysis for troubleshooting end to end performance and connectivity issues with tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, and iperfExperience with continuous integration/continuous delivery tools (Git, Jenkins, etc.) and configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, SaltStack) to allow operations teams to adopt network automationFamiliarity interacting with APIs as well as the ability to read common data models and markup languages such as YANG and JSON for helping customers better understand how to interact programmatically with networksExperience in assisting the Senior leadership team to design technology, process landscape and develop an overall solution strategy Proven experience migrating legacy network environments to modern ones in phased approaches to reduce downtime and mitigate riskExperience deploying Network Access Control solutions (Aruba, Cisco)

About the Role

This is not a traditional, siloed service desk role. We are actively seeking a candidate who is well-versed in troubleshooting and resolving issues within Ms Intune-managed environments, while also operating effectively across desktop support, endpoint management, security compliance, and network-related challenges. You will be expected to move fluidly across technical domains.
This means owning problems end-to-end rather than handing them off—while balancing user experience, security requirements, and operational efficiency. This role is in support of a secure and enterprise-scale environment with federally regulated compliance requirements.
Enterprise Desktop Administration
Build, image, configure, deploy, and maintain Windows workstations and peripherals using gold images and templates
Administer Active Directory-sourced user and computer objects and provide continuous compliance oversight using Group Policy controls
Procure, track, and keep up-to-date software products and associated licensing
Design, implement, and maintain MS Intune endpoint management solutions.
Procure and issue desktops with Intune Autopilot zero-touch provisioning
Build automation using PowerShell and MS Graph where appropriate

Identify, prioritize, and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities using enterprise management and security tools
Navigate and resolve security and compliance-related challenges, including endpoint hardening, policy enforcement, and audit readiness
End User Support
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff while maintaining a high level of customer service
Troubleshoot Windows operating systems, peripherals, printers, conferencing equipment, and endpoint hardware
Diagnose and address network connectivity issues (e.g., access restrictions, firewall rules, DNS, VPN, IP/Port/URL filtering)
Demonstrate the flexibility to contribute across endpoint engineering, user support, compliance, and operational initiatives as business priorities evolve
Continuously improve endpoint management processes through automation, standardization, and operational excellence

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in information systems or relevant field and 5+ years practical experience in the field
Ability to obtain public trust clearance.
Ability to self-manage work tasks using M365-based tools
Demonstrated and proven ability to independently resolve issues, improve day-to-day operations with self-driven initiatives, and operate with a growth mindset
Hands-on experience administering or operating network access controls in the form of IP: Port or URL-based filters
Practical experience managing enterprise desktops within an MS Intune managed environment
Hands-on experience troubleshooting and administering Windows operating systems in an enterprise environment - ideally including peripheral device management, asset management, and VOIP operations
Understanding and practical exposure to regulatory controls, baselines, and security policies within an Azure Entra and Intune-based environment with enterprise desktops and endpoints (CIS benchmarks, STIG, etc)
Located near Indianapolis, IN, and is both willing and capable of being on-site daily in support of the mission

jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer — MDM (Profisee)

Location: Dallas, TX (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time | Contract

About the Role

You''ll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer — configure it, connect it, and keep golden records flowing cleanly into the downstream warehouse.

This is an implementation role, not an advisory one. You''ll write code, configure match rules, and debug pipeline failures.

What You''ll Do

· Configure and tune Profisee match and survivorship rules for Client and Advisor entities (probabilistic + deterministic matching, confidence thresholds, conflict resolution).

· Build and maintain the integration between Databricks Delta Lake and Profisee — ingestion of staging records into Profisee, and write-back of golden records to the Lakehouse.

· Set up the Profisee stewardship portal for data steward workflows — exception queues, match review, and record correction.

· Work with upstream pipeline engineers to ensure records are correctly partitioned and flagged before they hit the MDM layer.

· Monitor MDM pipeline health — match rates, queue depth, golden record lag — and fix issues when they arise.

· Document match rules, survivorship decisions, and integration patterns for the team.

Must-Have

· 3+ years with Profisee MDM — you''ve implemented it, not just administered it. You know match rules, survivorship policies, and Profisee Connect.

· Strong SQL and Python — you can write and debug pipeline code independently.

· Profisee integration experience — connecting Profisee to an external data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, or equivalent) via API or connector.

· Match/merge configuration — candidate generation, scoring, threshold tuning, and survivorship.

· Cloud environment experience — AWS or Azure.

Nice to Have

· Databricks / Delta Lake experience (DLT, MERGE, Change Data Feed).

· Financial services domain knowledge — client data, advisor data, accounts.

· Experience with other MDM tools (Reltio, Informatica, Semarchy).

· Kafka / event-driven pipeline experience.

jobs.description:
*** IMPORTANT ***

You must be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship (U.S. citizens or green card holders only)You must live within commuting distance of downtown Columbus, Ohio.

Organization Summary

FCDC provides cost-effective, business-driven, collaborative, and secure IT services and solutions to public service agencies throughout Ohio’s most dynamic county. Our goals are simple but expansive: to be the most trusted enterprise technology service provider for Franklin County and a national leader in digital government services. Every day the FCDC team empowers local government departments, agencies, teams, and nonprofits to deliver top-notch services to residents and businesses in central Ohio, and we take pride in the work they accomplish with our support.

Job Summary

Endpoint Engineers play a critical role in architecting and caring for the digital experience of Franklin County employees. They continuously research, design, deploy, administer, monitor, and collaboratively support complex end user hardware-and-software solutions (endpoints) that put the power of modern technologies into the hands of thousands of colleagues every day, each of whom plays a role in delivering vital public services to central Ohio residents.

Our best Endpoint Engineers think deeply about how our end users experience their PCs, smartphones, and other tech at their fingertips—not just how those devices are configured technically. Our Engineers manage endpoint features and lifecycles with tools like Microsoft Intune, but the “north star” for this role is to continuously answer this question: Does this technology make someone's workday easier, faster, and less frustrating?

If you believe Microsoft, Apple, and Google products—out of the box—are just not ready for normal users, and you’re ready to actively partner with our Help Desk team, our Security team, and our customers to build a better user experience, then this is the job for you.

This is the “it just works” team, ensuring our public servants get trustworthy digital Swiss Army knives they can use intuitively anywhere, anytime.

Employees new to FCDC or promoted into new positions must complete a 180-day probationary period, and all employees must adhere to current Employee Handbook policies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, Endpoint Engineers must be able to carry out each essential duty in a reliable and user‑focused manner. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The following responsibilities apply to all Endpoint Engineer levels (1, 2, and 3):

Support Windows client environments—including device configuration, Group Policy consumption, and Active Directory user/device object management—while maintaining readiness to assist with additional operating systems as they are adopted.Assist with Microsoft 365 application management and troubleshooting (Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint), Azure AD groups and permissions, and endpoint-related Enterprise Mobility Suite features in collaboration with peer teams.Use and maintain endpoint management tools such as Intune, Autopilot, SCCM, and MDM solutions in partnership with Enterprise Support and Security teams.Plan, schedule, and communicate client-impacting upgrade or maintenance events, ensuring coordination with application owners and users.Help produce documented testing and integration plans for onboarding new client systems, applications, and services.Follow established change management procedures for all client-related deployments, fixes, and configuration updates.Create and maintain clear documentation for endpoint processes, build steps, configuration standards, and client-related cloud workflow diagrams.Stay current on industry trends and emerging endpoint technologies that support modern device management.Identify opportunities to improve device performance, user experience, productivity tools, and endpoint service efficiency.Ensure endpoint operations align with regulatory requirements, audit standards, and organizational policies.Monitor M365 and related client applications for issues, outages, degraded performance, and functional impacts.Participate in ITIL‑based incident management and limited on‑call rotations, providing user‑focused troubleshooting, escalation, and resolution during regular and after‑hours support.Directly encourage professional and skills development in junior engineers and analysts and support cross-training efforts.Endpoint Engineers must also collaborate with a variety of FCDC teams, including:

IT leadership and architecture teams to align endpoint strategies with broader FCDC initiatives, and to provide input on device‑related policies, standards, and roadmaps.Support teams on equipment lifecycle activities, including device provisioning, refresh planning, and retirement workflows.Financial Services for vendor evaluations, hardware and software procurement, contract renewals, and coordinating third‑party service engagements.Server, Storage, and Cloud teams on client‑related integrations, without owning server/network infrastructure.Third‑party vendors to assist with device support, hardware services, application updates, and endpoint-focused projects.Project Managers and internal clients to support system upgrades, client-side maintenance tasks, technical debt remediation, and project planning activities—including work breakdown details, labor hour estimates, and technical requirements.All other FCDC technical and service delivery teams to ensure smooth cross-functional operations and a consistent, user‑focused technology experience.All other duties as assigned.Additional Information

Note: Levels 1, 2, and 3 are distinguished by specific measures of performance, education, and experience. The tables below outline standard boundaries between each of the levels. Keep in mind that years of service alone is not sufficient justification for promotion. An employee must demonstrate consistent next-level performance to become eligible for promotion.
